In your sleep you begin to have a vivid dream.
You see a village, a small town of simple people, and it is burning. You stand outside the village beside King Adrithyr. Before you there is a child, you cannot see it, yet you feel a hand around her, holding her tightly, a hug. The child looks up at you and says, "What is Elysium? My mother said I would get to go there one day."
Adrithyr reaches his hand out and offers you his forces. As his hand reaches out you feel the hand around the child, a young girl, move from a hug to lightly holding her by the throat.
You reach out your own hand and take Adrithyr's, his fingers grip your hand tightly, and the hand around the child's neck tightens. 
She looks at you with terror in her eyes, "Did you do this? Do I deserve to die?" She cries out in desperation as she is choked.
Adrithyr looks you in the eye and pulls you closer, as his grip tightens and becomes painful it starts to burn, the little girl is burning too, she screams "You did this to me! You let me die, ITS YOUR WAR TOO MELANTHA!"
As she screams the fire glows purple blue orange red and all colors, a fire of souls. Adrithyr's face changes as he smiles, half of it remaining his own, the other half becoming that of Ivar, as Arkonil, and a gigantic red dragon rise behind him.
You look past the monsters standing before you, past the dying child, and you see a river.
You awaken violently, immediately rising and your hand shooting to your back where the hilt of your sword usually is, but its at your bedside where you left it.
